items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: No, he was the president of 802. ... He was the last of the fixers of us.

ctx.x: No, he was the president of 802. Oh, yeah.

He was the last of the fixers of us. So about that time, the one thing that I wanted more than anything in the world was to go with Whiteman's band. On drums.
